content.comment_body: Hello, I'm looking to disable the password requirement for accessing the [product_name] web page, so users can go directly to a custom web interface. In the settings under 'Web server access,' I see 'Allow web server access' (which I can enable), but the 'Enable password protection for web server access' option is checked and cannot be changed because it's disabled. Is there a way to remove the need for password protection on the web server? I want users to be able to control simple actions, like turning a bulb on or off, without having to enter a password, as some users are reluctant to do so.

Unfortunately, those wishing to avoid passwords do not have an option here. Since the password request cannot be deactivated (option is greyed out), it appears impossible to bypass the web server login. However, you can set preferences for 'to customized site' and 'Keep me logged on,' and if you don't log out, you only need to click 'Log On' each subsequent visit, which simplifies access somewhat.
Hello, it's been some time and I'm still facing this issue. Has any solution become available?
Hi, just checking if there have been any updates or solutions to this issue after a couple of years?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are frustrated by the inability to turn off mandatory password protection for web server access in [product_name], as the related option is permanently disabled. This requirement is seen as unnecessary for simple controls, making it harder for users who prefer convenience. The ongoing nature of this problem with no solution over several years suggests a lack of flexibility and user-oriented improvement in the product's web server settings.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope for the option to remove or disable required password protection for the web server, allowing for faster, easier access to customized pages without login barriers.
